summary: The implementation correctly adds HMAC-signed cursor encoding and decoding with constant-time verification, satisfying all ticket requirements while preserving legacy behavior.
key_findings: encode_cursor and decode_cursor are implemented using HMAC-SHA256 as specified.
decode_cursor uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison, preventing timing attacks.
Tampered cursors and negative offsets correctly raise ValueError('invalid_cursor').
Legacy clamp_limit function remains unchanged and tests pass.
All 3 unit tests pass with exit code 0.
